label: Lesbian
description: A woman whose primary romantic/sexual attraction is to other women.

label: Gay
description: Primary romantic/sexual attraction to the same gender.

label: Bisexual
description: Romantic/sexual attraction to more than one gender.

label: Asexual
description: Experiences little or no sexual attraction.

label: Aromantic
description: Experiences little or no romantic attraction.

label: Queer
description: Umbrella term used when a more specific label is not confirmed or appropriate.

label: Questioning
description: In the process of exploring their own sexual orientation or gender identity.

label: Unlabeled
description: Explicitly does not use a specific label for their orientation.

label: Transgender
description: Gender identity differs from sex assigned at birth.

label: Nonbinary
description: Gender identity outside the male/female binary.

label: Genderfluid
description: Gender identity that shifts over time.

label: Genderqueer
description: Gender identity that rejects or expands binary categories.

label: Two-Spirit
description: A gender identity used by some Indigenous North Americans encompassing cultural, spiritual, sexual, and gender roles.

label: Intersex
description: Born with sex characteristics that don't fit typical binary notions of male or female bodies.

label: Travesti
description: A trans-feminine gender identity and cultural/political identity distinct from 'transgender woman,' rooted in Latin American (especially Brazilian and Argentine) trans and sex-worker communities.

label: Polyamorous
description: Practices or is open to consensual relationships with multiple partners.

label: Relationship Anarchist
description: Rejects predefined relationship structures and hierarchies.
